Drugs occupy 4-6 pages each; a few have a trailing blank page (PDF 509, 531, 541, 549, 555) recorded in unattributedPages.
Front matter roman pages i-xvi = PDF 1-17; back matter printed 545-571 = PDF 562-588.
Drug-entry band = PDF pages 18-560 (101 drugs); blank separator page 561 precedes the indices.
